name: team-delivery
title: Team delivery with personas
summary: One stage per persona (product, UX, architecture, security, data, build, test, DevOps, reviews); come in at any stage, run one, several or all, each as its own ask in the project.

stages.name: requirements
stages.goal: Agree the problem, users, acceptance criteria and backlog.
stages.exit: The user approves the PRD and its acceptance criteria.
stages.skip_when: A PRD with acceptance criteria already exists.

stages.name: ux-design
stages.goal: Design journeys, flows and screens with a clickable prototype.
stages.exit: The user clicks through and accepts the flows.

stages.name: solution-architecture
stages.goal: Choose the architecture, components and interfaces.
stages.exit: The user picks one option; dependencies are pinned.
stages.skip_when: The architecture is already decided and documented.

stages.name: security-architecture
stages.exit: The user accepts the threat model and controls.
stages.skip_when: No new data, identities or external exposure.

stages.name: data-architecture
stages.goal: Data model, storage, migration and data protection.
stages.exit: The user accepts the data model and migration plan.

stages.name: architecture-review
stages.goal: Review the solution, security and data designs before building.
stages.skip_when: Small change within an approved architecture.

stages.name: data-build
stages.goal: Build schemas, migrations and data access as verified features.

stages.name: build
stages.goal: Build the services and logic as verified features.

stages.name: ui-build
stages.goal: Build the user interface as verified features with screenshots.
stages.exit: Every UI feature check passes with screenshots.

stages.name: data-science
stages.goal: Analysis or model with data, method, metrics and evaluation.
stages.exit: The user accepts the method and evaluation results.

stages.name: test-strategy
stages.goal: Test strategy traced to the acceptance criteria.
stages.exit: The user accepts the test strategy.
stages.skip_when: Feature checks cover the acceptance criteria.

stages.name: test
stages.goal: Automated integration, end-to-end and regression tests as verified features.
stages.exit: Every test feature passes and every earlier check passes again.
stages.skip_when: Feature checks are the full test set.

stages.name: devops
stages.goal: Pipelines, infrastructure as code and environments as verified features.
stages.exit: The pipeline deploys to the target environment and its checks pass.

stages.name: code-review
stages.goal: Review the code built in this project.

stages.name: security-review
stages.goal: Review the design and code for security weaknesses.

stages.name: ux-review
stages.goal: Review the built screens against the design, usability and accessibility.

stages.name: test-review
stages.goal: Review the tests and results for coverage and reliability.

stages.name: product-review
stages.goal: Check the delivery against the PRD and decide release readiness.
stages.exit: The user accepts the release decision.
